newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd Q3 net falls, sees modest 1996.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd Q3 net falls, sees modest 1996.

text.p: Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Wednesday its third-quarter net profit from ordinary operations fell to 38 million guilders ($22.2 million) from 63 million in the same period of 1995.
But Nedlloyd said that if gains on asset sales were stripped out of the figures, ordinary net profit showed a rise to 36 million guilders from 19 million.
Nedlloyd, which has merged its container shipping operations with those of Britain's P&O, said it expected a modest net profit for the whole of 1996.

"Taking into account that the fourth quarter is generally weak for Nedlloyd, we expect for Nedlloyd as a whole to end the year with a modestly positive result on ordinary activities after taxation," it said. ($ = 1.711 Dutch Guilders)
